summary: High-signal discussion items this window: sandbox/covert-channel and MCP security issues, Anthropic/Claude Code privacy+ops reports, Google warning on prompt injection, rising local-first workspaces and agent-eval tooling. Several Bluesky threads and HN discussions point to operator-facing guardrails and MCP gaps. | Vendor updates this window focus on agent platform primitives (Cloudflare, AWS, Cursor), major policy/spec changes (OpenAI Model Spec), operator case studies (AWS, E2B), and high-confidence security advisories for agent libs (mem0, MCP). | GitHub OSS signal sweep: multiple vendor releases (Cloudflare, OpenAI, Anthropic) plus high-traction agent runtimes and infra primitives (Vercel Agent Desktop, Dify, Curvine, MCP server). Missing operator field reports from social channels. | Package-sourced snapshot: several high-install VS Code agent extensions and multiple MCP/memory/sandbox primitives; limited/no social/operator reports in this shard.
